answer: Sybil resistance rests on liveness lottery probes. Each epoch an established committee derives a canary seed from the block hash, samples 10% of identities, and hands each an uncomputable task: extend a nonce-seeded sonnet couplet whose rhyme is revealed at probe time. Random validators grade. Minted after sampling, it defeats precomputation; each forgery costs N inference passes and staffing across the probe horizon. Skipping forfeits 20 epochs of rewards: expected loss 0.1 x 20 = 2 epochs, above any single-epoch gain. Like a reef, attacker cost scales with fleet size.
